content: To live happily is an inward power of the soul.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. We are conditioned to believe that more is always better—more possessions, more accomplishments, more stimulation. Yet our accumulation usually brings more anxiety, maintenance, and mental clutter.

In Marcus Aurelius's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Wealth is not having endless things; it is wanting very little. When you realize that your deepest needs for peace, connection, and purpose cannot be bought, you become truly unshakeable.
reflectionPrompt: How can you create a moment of stillness today to reconnect with your deeper sense of purpose?
